caveat: Philosophical essay with no empirical material. Its complexity canon is Morin, Davis and Sumara, Mason, with Haraway, Latour and Biesta alongside; Juarrero, Levin and Tsing do not appear.
source: Consensus; Journal watch: Educational Philosophy and Theory
title: Forget complexity, but not its reach: Rethinking responsibility in education
why: Argues complexity now matters as an ethical and ontological sensitivity to interdependence rather than as system explanation, and proposes close-range forgetting with long-range remembering. The closest published argument to the substrate question you are taking to CARN.
